comment: Authority-domain registry — shared source of truth for BOTH source scoring (scripts/36, 32) and collection sweeps (scripts/60_authority_domain_sweep.py). Root-cause fix for issue #75: high-authority domains were classified but never enumerated as collection targets. collection.type: wordpress_search = enumerable ?s= endpoint (verified 2026-09-25); dedicated_crawler = one-off script already exists; web_search_fallback = endpoint blocked/JS/absent — use site:domain queries via agent/02/03.

aikidojournal.com.label: Aikido Journal — long-running edited publication, authoritative on aikido history
aikidojournal.com.notes: Verified server-rendered ?s= pagination. Also carries Encyclopedia entries at /YYYY/MM/DD/<name>/ paths.

maytt.home.blog.label: Martial Arts of Yesterday, Today and Tomorrow — Antonio Aloia's interview blog; original interviews, watch for AJ reprints
maytt.home.blog.notes: WordPress.com. CAUTION: MAYTT republishes AJ originals verbatim — check 'previously appeared in' notes before counting as a separate source (see src:maytt-ikeda-2019 demotion).

aikiweb.com.label: AikiWeb — aikido seminar/dojo database
aikiweb.com.notes: Seminar listings already covered by dedicated per-country/state crawl.

newspapers.com.label: Newspapers.com — newspaper scan access host
newspapers.com.notes: NPC corpus pipeline exists; coverage is query-driven per subject.

blackbeltmag.com.label: Black Belt Magazine — legacy martial arts magazine
blackbeltmag.com.notes: Wix site — ?s= returns JS app shell, not results. Legacy print coverage best found via Google Books volumes.
